subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace demo - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@cloudbridge.com>, partners@cloudbridge.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace demo - next steps

Thanks again for a productive call earlier today — great to hear more about CloudBridge's marketplace roadmap and the integration points that could help your partners discover Redwood Inference. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: CloudBridge is prioritizing a native marketplace listing and an integration with their deployment templates; interest in a technical deep-dive focused on appliance/packaging options, auth/KV patterns, and quantization guidance.
- Next step: 60–75 minute technical deep dive/demo with our infra and runtime engineers to walk through integration patterns + Q&A.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon Apr 26, 10:00–11:15am
- Tue Apr 27, 1:00–2:15pm
- Wed Apr 28, 9:00–10:15am

Can you share which of those work, and please confirm the best attendee list from your side? We'll include our runtime lead (Lukas), solutions engineer (Camila), and product manager as needed. I attached a short partner deck and will follow up with a draft agenda once we confirm a time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: RWI-Partner-Deck.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Chang <alex.chang@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace demo - next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note and the recap. Great summary.

All three proposed slots look doable from our side except Tue Apr 27 (we have a leadership offsite that afternoon). The best options would be:
- Mon Apr 26, 10:00–11:15am PST ✅
- Wed Apr 28, 9:00–10:15am PST ✅

Attendees from CloudBridge: Alex Chang (me), Emma Li (Marketplace PM), and two systems engineers (TBD). Would you expect your runtime lead to cover benchmarking and packaging details, and Camila to cover implementation/onboarding? Also please send over the draft agenda and any environment pre-reqs so our engineers can prepare.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chang
Partnerships Manager, CloudBridge
alex.chang@cloudbridge.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chang <alex.chang@cloudbridge.com>, partners@cloudbridge.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace demo - next steps

Thanks Alex — Mon the 26th at 10am PST works for us. Confirming attendees from Redwood: Lukas Meyer (Runtime Lead), Camila Reyes (Solutions Engineer), Marissa Cole (Partner Manager). Lukas will cover runtime/benchmarking and packaging options; I'll cover integration touchpoints and onboarding flow.

Draft agenda attached (technical-deep-dive-agenda.docx) — short running order:
- 10:00–10:10 Introductions & goals (Marissa + Alex)
- 10:10–10:30 Packaging & deployment patterns (Lukas)
- 10:30–10:55 Auth/KV caching + integration examples (Camila)
- 10:55–11:05 Q&A / action items
- 11:05–11:15 Next steps & mutual action plan

Pre-reqs for the engineers:
- Read the attached agenda and the partner deck (high-level)
- If possible, bring any example manifest or packaging constraints (e.g., CloudBridge template limits)

Attachment: technical-deep-dive-agenda.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Marissa — can you send the calendar invite once Alex confirms?

— Camila
Camila Reyes | Solutions Engineer, Partnerships
camila_reyes@redwood.com

From: Alex Chang <alex.chang@cloudbridge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace demo - next steps

Perfect — Mon Apr 26, 10:00–11:15am PST is confirmed on our side. Invited Emma Li and two engineers (IDs pending). I’ve added a placeholder calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudbridge-rwi-demo — please update with the final guest list and any dial-in details.

We’ll have our engineers review the agenda and share any manifest constraints by EOD Friday so we can make the session productive. Looking forward to the deep dive.

Thanks,
Alex
Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (text/calendar)
